title: Fideon canonical schema - boppr (policy_check)
description: SPEC_21 section 4 canonical schema for boppr, businessowners property (L1 code boppr), composing common_model.json 1.4.0 by $ref: the envelope plus the locations and buildings blocks the property lines use. Built from the five single-LOB businessowners property documents of the source-data boppr folder (3 carriers, read in place), every field of the pre-SPEC_21 boppr.json 1.5.0 (boppr.crosswalk.yaml) and the line's L1 registry YAML. Package documents (bopgl_boppr, boppr_cgl) are not read for this schema. No LOB block. 2.2.0 adds the G1/bop review: the two businessowners declarations of that folder (Utica First, NYCM) were read for coverage names and field captions.
fideon:status: SPEC_21 Phase 2 schema (10 October 2026), built from 5 seed documents of 3 carriers; replaces the pre-SPEC_21 boppr.json 1.5.0 (policy_core). Draft for the project owner's approval; the 5 seed golds drafted against it are DRAFT, pending reviewer sign-off. 2.1.0 (23 October 2026, additive, DECISIONS row 114/115): composes common model 1.4.0; cross-copies printed row names from bopgl, adds the cyber-endorsement data restoration code and one field caption (loan number). No path, code or alias is removed or renamed, so the 2.0.0 golds, varmaps and readers keep working; each seed's review stamp is for the seed reviewer to renew. 2.2.0 (25 October 2026, additive, G1/bop folder): coverage-code names printed by the Utica First Businessowners Special Policy (with its Maximizer package endorsement) and the NYCM BP 00 03 declarations become aliases of the existing codes, ten concepts no code covered get a code on both lines, bopgl gets the counterparts of fifteen boppr codes, and distinctive field captions are added. No path, code or alias is removed or renamed, so the 2.1.0 golds, varmaps and readers keep working. 2.3.0 (26 October 2026, additive): coverage-code names and codes for the coverage rows printed by the G1 scanned and hybrid seed documents (change request approved by the project owner). No path, code or alias is removed or renamed.

corpora: G1/bop (6 documents read in place: 2 businessowners declarations, 3 Contractors Special Policy documents and 1 commercial package policy, which are not businessowners)

recurring_wording_review.corpus: POLICIES-FINAL-V3, original documents, read locally only
recurring_wording_review.rule: a line is kept only when it prints in 5 or more different documents of 2 or more carrier folders, has no digit run of 4 or more, and every word is itself used in 10 or more carrier folders; counts and codes only, no page text or value is stored

carriers: New York Central Mutual Fire Insurance Company
g1_bop_review.rule: a coverage name is added when a businessowners declarations in the folder prints it as a coverage row; labels and codes only, no page text or value is stored

fideon:lob_block: None. Every concept the seeds print has a home in the envelope or a common-model building block (SPEC_21 4.2.4). Business liability rows printed on a businessowners property declarations (Coverage L, M, N, O, P) are coverages of this line under BOPPR_ codes (X_MED_PAY shared); The common model 1.3.0 releases the shared liability codes CR-BOPPR-01 asked for (X_BI_PD_LIABILITY, X_PRODUCTS_COMPLETED_OPS, X_DAMAGE_TO_PREMISES_RENTED, X_PERSONAL_ADVERTISING_INJURY); the rename to them is a major version of the line (CHANGE_REQUESTS_boppr.md CR-BOPPR-01). bopgl and boppr print the same Section I property beside Section II liability: every row both lines print has a counterpart code on the other line (the `counterpart` key of the coverage-code file) and the same printed names.
fideon:audit_rules: premium.total == sum(coverages[].premium) + sum(forms_and_endorsements[].premium) + sum(premium.items[].amount) + sum(premium.surcharges[].amount) + sum(premium.discounts[].amount) + sum(premium.taxes_fees[].amount) ± 0.01
fideon:audit_rules_note: Rules 1-4 are common_model.json fideon:default_audit_rules (the claims-made rule left out: no businessowners property document prints a retroactive date). Rule 5: an each-occurrence liability limit never exceeds its aggregate. Rule 6 holds on all 5 seeds: credits are negative amounts (premium.discounts[] and forms_and_endorsements[].premium), and a premium printed 'Incl.' parses to null and adds nothing; a carrier's printed subtotals ('Coverage Premium', 'Property Total') are additional_fields, not premium items. A rule whose values a document does not print is not evaluated.
